.. change::
    :tags: bug, autogenerate
    :tickets: 1877

    Fixed regression where autogenerate no longer detected changes to
    :class:`~sqlalchemy.schema.Identity` or
    :class:`~sqlalchemy.schema.Computed` column defaults, and no longer
    emitted the "Computed default cannot be modified" warning, unless
    ``compare_server_default`` were set.  Identity and computed comparison
    are once again performed independently of that option, as they were
    through the 1.17 series.
